lyrics:
[verse]
Clean my room? said Bruno, my,
I'll do it when the pigs can fly!
Then Bruno searched the whole wide sky,
For piggies floating way up high!
[chorus]
When pigs fly, when pigs fly,
It means never, nice try, goodbye!
When pigs fly, when pigs fly,
Don't hold your breath or sit and sigh!
[verse]
It's a thing that won't come true,
No matter what you say or do,
A silly day that won't arrive,
Like little pigs with wings to fly!
[chorus]
When pigs fly, when pigs fly,
It means never, nice try, goodbye!
When pigs fly, when pigs fly,
So don't you wait and watch the sky!
[outro]
So when it's never, that's the why,
Just grin and shrug and wave goodbye!
